text_block_list.text:
"On our way back from an outing with Sweep Tosho,
we took a slight detour, when..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
Wait, that girl!

Following Sweep Tosho's gaze,
I saw a large Siberian Husky
lying in front of a rice field.

It appears to be a rather elderly dog,
yet it carries itself with the dignified aura of a wolf.
Though it seems to be leashed...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Their coat is so gorgeous,
and their eyes are so deep...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's decided!
I'm making that girl my familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That presence is extraordinary.
Sent by some great sage, she's been protecting this land since ancient times!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Let's take them back to the dorm! First thing's first, we're taking a bath together!

It clearly belongs to someone else, but Sweep Tosho seems utterly dazzled by its sheer charm.
In order to stop her without dampening her excitement...
choice_data_list: My other familiars might get jealous, you know?
If you can convince her, then I'll think about it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?

Sweep Tosho has other
stuffed-animal familiars by her side.
If I can appeal to her love for them, maybe I can steer her...
choice_data_list: Let's head back for now and hear what the other girls think.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Haaah?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm the master here,
so there's no problem with me deciding!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Besides, even if the other familiars got jealous—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~?
I figured it out.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You just want all my orders to yourself, don't you?!
That's why you don't want me getting any more familiars!
...Hearing her say that reminded me that I was her familiar.
choice_data_list: Are you feeling a little lonely...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun!
I thought so!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You really are a hopeless familiar!
Talking back just because you're lonely... frankly,
you're the lowest of the low for a familiar, but~...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It'd be a pain if my familiars fought with each other anyway!
I'll let you have it. You'd better be grateful!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
In exchange, you're gonna be my legs!
Carry me on your back!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously! I lost my chance
to ride on such a huge dog!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, crouch down!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heyyy!
It's shaking, I feel sick! I wanna get off after all~!

And so, in exchange for giving up on getting a dog,
I headed home while diligently fulfilling my duties as a familiar...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Then it's settled, I'm taking you back with me! Persuasion is my specialty, after all!

And so, with a pounding heart, I ended up
watching over the attempt to persuade Sweep Tosho.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you!
I've got some great news for you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll make you my familiar!
Well? Aren't you thrilled?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You're ignoring meee!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's the deal?!
You get to work under me, you know?
Aren't you happy about that?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: At least say "woof" or "meow" or something~!

The dog suddenly looks back. A Shiba Inu
slowly approaches from behind him...
Seemingly even older than him, its pace is slow.

He quietly watches over those unsteady steps with a steady gaze.
Apparently, he's a dog from the neighborhood.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Never mind, changed my mind!
I don't want that one!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I told you I don't want it!
If you look closely, it's all crumpled
and not cute at all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...The two of you can just go ahead
and play together forever for all I care!
choice_data_list: ...I hope those kids stay together forever.
...I hope those kids stay together forever, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I don't know!
...Do whatever you want!

Despite her complaints, Sweep Tosho gave a gentle
smile at the end, walking away with a refreshed look on her face.
